claims.natural_statement: For the exact conc:degree incidences one may take C_e=2 in every dimension; in codimension at least two one may take C_e=1.

In the affine-line case of conc:degree there exist an even-dimensional subspace A of E, dim A=2m>=2, and an alternating form C on A such that V={z: Pf(z restricted to A minus C)=0}, deg V=m, and Lambda=P{(v,y):v in A, y restricted to A=Cv}; conversely each such cylinder has the stated affine-line ruling on a dense open set.
For every integer table c(p,u) with c(p,0)=1, c(p,1)=p-2, and c(p+2,u+2)=binomial(p,u+2)+c(p,u), c(p,u)>=0 whenever u+1<=p. The second recurrence is used only with p>=2 in the first-degree base case.

For every finite three-index real tensor symmetric in its first two indices and skew in its last two indices, every entry vanishes; consequently the pointwise Hessian/Gram tensor in the null-graph rigidity proof vanishes.
For every c:Nat->Nat->Int satisfying c(p,0)=1, c(p,1)=p-2 and c(p+2,u+2)=binomial(p,u+2)+c(p,u) for all p,u, c(p,u)>=0 whenever u+1<=p.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace ConcentrationDegree

theorem coefficient_nonnegative
    (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ)
    (hzero : ∀ p, c p 0 = 1)
    (hone : ∀ p, c p 1 = (p : ℤ) - 2)
    (hstep : ∀ p u, c (p + 2) (u + 2) =
      (Nat.choose p (u + 2) : ℤ) + c p u) :
    ∀ u p, u + 1 ≤ p → 0 ≤ c p u := by
  intro u
  induction u using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h u ih =>
    intro p hp
    rcases u with _ | u
    · rw [hzero]
      norm_num
    rcases u with _ | u
    · rw [hone]
      have hp' : (2 : ℤ) ≤ (p : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
      omega
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 2 := ⟨p - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [hstep]
    have hprevious : 0 ≤ c q u := ih u (by omega) q (by omega)
    have hchoose : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (Nat.choose q (u + 2) : ℤ) :=
      Int.natCast_nonneg _
    omega

theorem symmetry_skew_vanish
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {I : Type*} (T : I → I → I → K)
    (hsym : ∀ i j k, T i j k = T j i k)
    (hskew : ∀ i j k, T i j k = -T i k j) :
    ∀ i j k, T i j k = 0 := by
  intro i j k
  have hneg : T i j k = -T i j k := by
    calc
      T i j k = T j i k := hsym i j k
      _ = -T j k i := hskew j i k
      _ = -T k j i := congrArg Neg.neg (hsym j k i)
      _ = -(-T k i j) := congrArg Neg.neg (hskew k j i)
      _ = T k i j := neg_neg _
      _ = T i k j := hsym k i j
      _ = -T i j k := hskew i k j
  have htwo : (2 : K) * T i j k = 0 := by
    linear_combination hneg
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)

end ConcentrationDegree

claims.natural_statement: Over every characteristic-zero field and every index type, a three-index tensor symmetric in its first two positions and antisymmetric in its last two positions vanishes identically.

In the actual conc:rulings construction, K_v has an affine-linear normalized basis and the first horizontal tangency tests have degree at most two in the free coordinate. A finite incidence has generic degree at most two, or at most one in codimension at least two; all first tests identically zero yield the full affine-line case.

For an irreducible V of dimension s0+h, 1<=h<=e-2, with no dominating affine-line contained-flat incidence, the degrees of the distinct dominating parameter components sum to at most 2 deg V. In codimension at least two the bound is deg V. The constant 2 is sharp, achieved by z23=z12*z13 at e=3 with two degree-two parameter conics.

The manuscript sparse-cone exclusion handles arbitrarily slow M/A tending to zero and both endpoint configurations. This remains a separate unverified obligation.
The remaining interpolation, motion and incidence reductions needed for thm:main are valid. This mission does not certify this remaining bundle of obligations.
